description: This file contains functions for generating digests (hashes) of dashboards and charts in Apache Superset, incorporating user-specific and RLS (Row Level Security) filters, and handling executor types.

methods.name: _adjust_string_for_executor
methods.description: Appends the executor to the unique string if the thumbnail is user-specific.

methods.name: _adjust_string_with_rls
methods.description: Adds RLS filters to the unique string based on current executor and datasources.

methods.name: get_dashboard_digest
methods.description: Generates a hash digest for a dashboard, incorporating RLS filters and executor info.

methods.name: get_chart_digest
methods.description: Generates a hash digest for a chart, incorporating RLS filters and executor info.
